Name: Micah, Father of Mattaniah
Summary: Father of Mattaniah the Levite, son of Zichri son of Asaph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:15: Father of Mattaniah the Levite, son of Zichri son of Asaph.
LifeLesson: The mention of Micah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
